_doc: The Lernbuch (story 10.5, learning/lernbuch.js, ui/screens/LernbuchScreen.js): per subject (learning topic) a bar of the real accuracy (correct / answered over everything the kid answered) and badges, all from the saved learning stats. medals: the best one whose `answered` and `accuracy` are both reached (bronze, silver, gold; a medal is a promise, not a punishment: below bronze the bar just shows how far along the kid is). badges: `streak` = best run of right answers at least `streakMin`; `learner` = at least `learnedMin` questions learned for good (the repetition queue let them go). barColors: accuracy from `min` up.
